name: Mag All
description: While the connector is active the end will glow and it will stick to most surfaces that it touches. The connection will break if enough stress (200) is applied.
shortDescription: A small connector that will attach to most surfaces.

logicNodes.label: Magnet Toggle
logicNodes.description: Enables the connector's magnet when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Connected
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if the connector is attached to another connector.

logicNodes.label: Force
logicNodes.description: Outputs the current force stress on the connector.
